items.title: Mobs of the Month - August
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
August brings you a colorful pack of sci-fi, futuristic mob designs. Neon colors, geometric lines. Perfect for galactic exploration, alien invasions, time travel, and more.
15 mob skins in all.

items.title: Aesthetic Streetwear
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
It's time to gear up into some stylish outfits! With hoodies, jeans and cool shirts, this pack includes a wide variety of clothes to show off!

+ 12 teen skins
+ Awesome streetwear outfits

items.title: Simple Fashion
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
These outfits really prove that less is more. Put on one of these simplistic outfits to instantly make your friends jealous!

+ 12 teenage skins
+ Cool stylish outfits

items.title: Summer Fashion
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
It's time to go on vacation! Summer season is here! These cute outfits will make you stand out from the crowd! So, which outfit are you choosing?

- 6 unique summer skins
- Perfect for roleplay
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Xenon Design.

items.title: Exceptional
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Wear one of these crazy skins with your favorite color to play with your friends! Are you the fortunate or the unlucky one during a fight?

+ 20 awesome HD skins
+ 2 colors variations
- By Pixelusion & Golimane

items.title: Spaceman Fashion
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Join your crew with these amazing and fashionable astronaut skins, but careful there is something scary lurking in the dark... Try looking around using these trendy and stylish suits.

- 60 colorful astronauts to choose from!
- Includes 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Pixel Smile Studios

items.title: Red White and Blue
items.creator: Impulse
items.description: Celebrate in style with these super cute red, white, and blue skins! Perfect for summertime! With 12 skins to choose from, you can match your friends and find a skin perfect for you!

items.title: Cowboys
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Take a ride and bring the cows back to the herd. And Live a western Life with your friends. 

+ Cowboy
+ Cowgirl
+ Roleplay

Created by Mine-North

items.title: 90s Style
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
90s fashion is bigger than ever right now! Pick from classic retro styles from the 1990s!

- 8 skins!
- Wide variety of outfit designs and colors, pick one that suits you best!

items.title: E-Fashion!
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description: Interested in fashion? What about E-Fashion? A new trend popular with teens! Dress in cute dungarees, cool plaid or dye your hair crazy rainbow colors! Express your best e-style as one of these stylish teens! Kawaii anime or gloomy goth? You decide with this new skin pack!

items.title: Secret Desert Base
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description:
Welcome to your new survival base! Hidden away inside the desert mountains, no one will find you here! This has everything you’d ever need from a survival base from farms to living areas and bedrooms! Got an unexpected visitor? Use the house’s trap systems to avoid any problems!

Hidden survival base!
Traps!

items.title: Secret Modern Bunker
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description:
This isn’t just a normal modern house, it’s completely hidden underground! Complete with everything you’d ever need in your dream home from an indoor pool to a home theatre, you’ll never want to leave! Wanting somewhere to hang out with friends or somewhere to start your next survival adventure? Look no further!

Hidden modern house!
Full interior!
Secret entrance!

items.title: Maze Puzzle Parkour
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for a carefree and playful challenge with this multi-level maze, puzzle and parkour map?
Prepare yourself for a little bit of everything as you jump and solve your way through all the stages!
* Escape 15 epic levels! 
* Music included!
* Multiplayer friendly!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Mega Parkour
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Free yourself from all your worries as you prepare for some fun and exciting parkour? Jump your way through the levels and become the victor of this crazy map!
* 40+ levels
* Multiplayer friendly!
* Can you complete all the stages?
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Samurai Lucky Block
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: In an era of samurai, mysterious blocks appear in the world to bring fun. Adventure yourself and see how lucky you are!

items.title: Axolotls
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The axolotls are here! Put on your axolotls outfits and go conquer the sea and the underwater temples!
These axolotls outfits will allow you to perfectly fit in the underwater population!

+ 10 Axolotls skins

items.title: Cartoon Villagers
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
What is your favourite villager profession? Don't worry, they are all here! Choose your favourite profession and get to work with these cartoon villagers!

+ 12 cartoon themed skins
+ 2 free skins
+ Made by rvan

items.title: Lucky Blocks Parkour
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
This Lucky Blocks parkour map will challenge your skills!
Jump from block to block, get the loot from the Lucky Blocks and equip yourself to fight against the Wither.

But be careful.. Remember to save your items in the Ender chests!

+300 different outcomes!
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Advanced Weapons
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Time to pvp with advanced elemental weapons! Choose from a variety of elements from fire, ice, earth, poison, psychic, and thunder. Wield a battle axe, sharpen a sword, or be swift with a dagger! All of these elemental weapons will be craftable!

+ 15+ new weapons!
+ Special effects per weapon!
+ Custom attack animations!
+ Includes an elemental boss fight!

items.title: Vintage Anime Teens
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
Go back to the past with vintage anime teens! Get ready to shine with stylishly dressed and cool skins.

Includes
+ 2 free skins!
+ 12 Skins to chose from.

Created by xfaddy and Published by Kuboc Studios.

items.title: Element Endermen
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
After a long time, the Elemental Endermens are already here, now you can be one of them, and have fun with your friends.

+ 10 different Element Endermen skins.

Created by Lunatic Network and Published by Kuboc Studios.

items.title: Hacker Mobs
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Hacking servers, websites, and sabotaging games... what else could you want in your awesome hacker routine? The possibilities are endless with the Hacker Mobs skin pack! You can become a cool zombie or even a cute cow. Troll your friends and have fun!

- 10 skins
- By Street Studios

items.title: Among Mobs
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Guess who the impostor mobs are! Discover which of your friends are lying and oust them with the perfect skin pack!

+ 12 Skins
+ By DalibuStudios

items.title: Millionaire Summer Mansion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Millionaire Summer Mansion is a mansion with everything a millionaire needs! From decorated rooms to a beautiful pool, this mansion has tons of stuff for you to share with your friends! Explore your mansion and enjoy all the luxury it has to offer.

- Mega mansion
- Modern design
- Great with friends!
